contest.measure_text: SOUTH GATE FISCAL EMERGENCY STREET MAINTENANCE, YOUTH PROGRAMS, PARKS FUNDING PROTECTION MEASURE. Shall an ordinance preventing cuts to City of South Gate services including maintaining streets and sidewalks; maintaining school crossing guards, parks/recreation programs, police 911 and support services, and other General Fund uses by establishing an 8% utility user tax, exempting low income seniors, annually providing approximately $10,400,000 until ended by voters; requiring independent audits, public disclosure of all spending, local control, to benefit South Gate residents, be adopted? Supporters: Gil Hurtado, Councilmember; Hector De La Torre, Former Councilmember; South Gate POA; South Gate MEA; South Gate AYSO Opponents: California Taxpayers Association; Los Angeles County Taxpayers Association.
contest.office: CITY OF SOUTH GATE SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION - MEASURE SG
